title: Dr. J. W. Chenoweth — advertisement
text:
Dr. J. W. Chenoweth,
OCCULIST AND SURGEON;
Has Located Two Miles East of
Ky-Town, Grayson Co., Texas,
WHERE he is prepared to treat all kinds of diseased eyes, with full confidence of giving general satisfaction. He is also prepared to perform any operation on the eye, as well as any other Surgical operation that may be necessary.

Kentucky-Town, Oct. 23 1865.
notes: Printed advertisement clipping. 'Ky-Town' is an abbreviation for Kentucky-Town, an early Grayson County community.
